Student Conferences

Join the Learning Through Technology team at our annual hosted conferences for students!

  • The Learning Through Technology Team hosts the annual MLTI virtual student conference to engage students in a fun-filled day of technology learning and exploration.
  • The Learning Through Technology Team hosts the annual MLTI student conference to engage students in a fun-filled day of technology learning and exploration at the University of Maine's Orono campus.
Student Leadership Ambassadors

The Student Leadership Ambassadors of Maine (SLAM) initiative creates SLAM clubs in schools across Maine. The clubs offer students experiences with technology leadership.
